newsitem.title: UK: Buy out team to take over UK farm advice service.
newsitem.headline: Buy out team to take over UK farm advice service.

text.p: A management and employee buyout (MEBO) team is to take over the Ministry of Agriculture's ADAS farm advisory service in the government's latest privatisation, agriculture minister Douglas Hogg said on Wednesday.
"The overall net present value to the taxpayer of the MEBO bid is some 23.5 million stg," he said in answer to a written parliamentary question.
Hogg said this some comprised the consideration for the business plus savings flowing from the future price structure for services to the government and rents for properties.
Hogg said contracts should be exchanged very soon. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
